title: C++ Developer
summary: A C++ developer writes fast, reliable software in C++, such as trading systems, engineering and simulation tools, databases, networking software or desktop applications. They sit in a product engineering team and care a lot about performance, memory use and multithreaded code, mostly on Linux.
dailyDuties: Write and refactor C++ features from design documents
Debug crashes, memory leaks and race conditions
Profile slow code paths and improve performance
Write unit tests and keep the build green
Discuss designs with senior engineers and architects

skills.expectation: Write production C++ for application or systems software
Use C++11/14/17 features, the STL, smart pointers and RAII
Write and debug multithreaded code with threads, mutexes and condition variables
Choose data structures and algorithms that meet performance needs
Design classes and interfaces with object-oriented principles and design patterns
Build, run and debug code on Linux
Work in Git with branches and merge requests
Write unit tests with Google Test or similar
Script tests and tools in Python
Design components for performance and scale
